creator: ai.honeycove
title: Five free design tools for Claude: Taste Skill, Impeccable (design system + live browser editor), Playwright CLI (multi-browser screenshots/tests), Awesome DESIGN.md, and img2threejs (image to procedural Three.js model)

tools.name: Taste Skill
tools.detail: README 'Taste Skill', official website tasteskill.dev, 7.2k stars, 'Agent Skills Compatible', Cursor/Claude

tools.name: Impeccable
tools.detail: own design system + live editor in the browser (demo on a hotel site 'AURELIA')

tools.name: Playwright CLI
tools.detail: Claude spins up multiple browsers, tests, screenshots

tools.name: Awesome DESIGN.md
tools.detail: 'Curated collection of DESIGN.md analysis from developer focused websites', MIT license; design references: colors, typography, spacing, buttons

tools.name: img2threejs
tools.detail: 'Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural Three.js model... animation-ready, deliberately token-efficient - reconstruction-by-code, not photogrammetry'; Apache-2.0, Python 3.10+, Sponsored by Atlas Cloud

claims: Taste gives Claude actual design rules so you stop getting generic AI-looking websites
Impeccable improves front-end with its own design system and a live editor in the browser
Playwright CLI lets Claude open multiple browsers, test and screenshot automatically
Awesome DESIGN.md provides design systems inspired by real websites (typography, spacing, buttons, layouts)
img2threejs: give an image of a bike, Claude recreates it as an interactive 3D model entirely in code
how_to_steps: Install Taste Skill (tasteskill.dev) as an agent skill
Install Impeccable (`npx impeccable install`, then /impeccable init)
Add Playwright CLI for Claude to verify visually
Pull a DESIGN.md from Awesome DESIGN.md for a reference design system
Use img2threejs when you need a 3D object from a reference image
on_screen_only: Taste Skill README badges: OFFICIAL WEBSITE tasteskill.dev, stars 7.2k, AI Supported Cursor | Claude
'Before' slop example: purple gradient, generic placeholder, cards on cards, Inter font
Hacker News open in multiple Playwright browser windows
img2threejs README: 'Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural Three.js model... mesh extraction, or downloaded art packs'; red Ducati motorcycle demo

relevance.why: Four of the five (Taste, Impeccable, Playwright, awesome-design) are already in Haji's liked set; img2threejs is the only new tool and is niche

implement_score.why: Already covered; img2threejs could add a 3D hero object to a landing page in an afternoon but is a nice-to-have

verify: img2threejs repo owner, maintenance, and what the Atlas Cloud sponsorship implies (paid API?)
Taste Skill 7.2k stars figure at time of posting

gap.what: Mostly duplicate of liked design-skill roundups; only addition is img2threejs (image -> procedural Three.js model)
